description.zh: tr 翻译、dict AI 词典，支持 DeepL、微软翻译及 OpenAI 兼容模型服务；使用自己的密钥
description.en: tr translation and dict AI dictionary with your own DeepL, Microsoft Translator or OpenAI-compatible service key

notes.zh: 翻译服务返回 401、403 时显示“翻译服务的密钥不对或没有权限”，按 Enter 打开插件设置；402、429 和服务器出错时也直说是怎么回事（#444）。权限不变。
notes.en: On 401 or 403 the translation says the key is wrong or lacks permission, and Enter opens the plugin's settings; 402, 429 and server errors are named plainly too (#444). Permissions unchanged.
